summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss. Changes: (1) monai/losses/dice.py: added numpy and torch.nn.functional imports; new class after GeneralizedDiceLoss with constructor (dist_matrix, reduction), four helpers (wasserstein_distance_map, compute_weights_generalized_true_positives, compute_generalized_true_positive, compute_denominator), and forward returning the batch mean of 1 - (2*TP+smooth)/(D+smooth); added alias generalized_wasserstein_dice. (2) monai/losses/__init__.py: exports GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss. (3) tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py: new test module with binary 2D (correct, channel-dim, flipped) and empty-class (correct, flipped) cases. Not run, per instructions; expected values checked by hand. Added lines are within 120 columns; one pre-existing long line at dice.py:36 is untouched. Nothing committed. Small choices beyond spec: the matrix is cast to the probabilities' dtype as well as device, and the target is cast to long once in forward.
